info.title: Music Room API
info.description:
REST/JSON API of Music Room. Authenticate with `POST /auth/login` (or a social provider), then send `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`. Clients should also send `X-Client-Platform`, `X-Client-Device` and `X-Client-Version` on every request (used for the action logs).

Real time: connect with Socket.IO to the same host, `auth: { token: <accessToken> }`, then emit `subscribe` with `event:<id>`, `playlist:<id>` or `device:<id>` to receive `event:state`, `playlist:state` and `device:state` messages whose payload is the same object as the matching GET.

post.description: After 5 failed attempts the account is locked for 15 minutes.

Exchange a refresh token for a new session (rotation)
post.description: A refresh token is single use. Reusing one revokes the whole session (theft detection).

post.summary: Revoke a session
Send a password reset link by email
post.description: Always answers 204 so that it cannot be used to discover registered emails.

post.summary: Set a new password with a reset token
post.description: Revokes every open session of the account. JSON: 204, or 400 {error: WEAK_PASSWORD | INVALID_TOKEN}. The HTML form of the email link posts here too and gets an HTML page back.
